description: A test double (mock/stub) implementation for the CalendarProviderRegistry, used for unit testing other components that interact with calendar providers. It provides canned responses and simulates provider registration and retrieval without actual provider logic.

classes.name: FakeCalendarProviderRegistry
classes.description: A mock implementation of CalendarProviderRegistry that provides pre-configured providers and allows dynamic registration for testing purposes.

methods.name: addProvider
methods.description: Adds or overrides a provider source with specified authentication method.

methods.name: getAuthMethodForSource
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication method associated with a given provider source.

methods.name: getProviderForAccount
methods.description: Supposed to return a provider instance for an account but in this stub always returns null.

methods.name: getCalendarSourceTypes
methods.description: Returns list of configured calendar source types with display names.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the configured providers to default values.
